criteria.requirement: Repair Problem._getArgs so parsed string constraints live only in the current solve list, never get appended to the permanent explicit _constraints on every query. Preserve explicitly repeated constraints/callable objects, all existing string-expression semantics and each solver picklable policy; compile failures must not partially alter the model. reset clears string rules as well as regular constraints and variables. Repeated mixed string/function solving, solver changes and later variable declarations retain identical legal solution sets without model-list growth. Deliver a complete state-lifecycle repair, not a cache counter test.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
